info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Fitness Memberships Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Cancel Fitness Memberships API allows users to revoke their fitness memberships effectively. This endpoint is designed for customers seeking to discontinue their subscription services, ensuring a straightforward cancellation process. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline operations related to membership management, improve customer experience, and maintain accurate subscription records. Typical consumers include fitness center members and administrative staff managing membership records. Use cases include online membership management platforms and mobile applications.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel an existing membership. Upon a successful cancellation, the membership will be inactive, and any recurring payments will be halted.

requestBody.description: The request body for canceling a membership. It should specify the necessary details required for processing the cancellation.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelRequest.description: A request body for canceling memberships. This string should include the necessary identification or parameters for the cancellation.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelResponse_2.title: Cancel Membership Response

status.description: The status of the cancellation operation, indicating success (true) or failure (false).

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result generated from the cancellation process.

state.description: The current state of the membership after the cancellation attempt.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the cancellation process or its result.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelResponse_2.description: Response object for the cancel membership operation indicating the result of the cancellation request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that initiated the cancellation process.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Object containing details about the audit of the cancellation process.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
